text:
Maya: Quick sync 3: finalize reg page fields, Zoom record settings, filename conventions, and how leads get into HubSpot. I want clear owners and an ETA.

Priya: On it. We'll keep cloud recording + auto-transcript. Can we add a GDPR + UK data-consent checkbox and a small recording notice? Also want a hidden UTM param on the form for paid channels.

Jon: Ill own HubSpot mapping + integration. Plan: HubSpot form -> set props event_code:vl_0626_01, acquisition=paid|organic, tag=inference-interest. Watched tracking will flip lifecycle to MQL at >=60% watched. Fallback if HS API errors: drop CSV to s3://mktg-fallback/virtual_lab_0626/. Ill also queue a Clearbit enrichment job post-submit.

Sara: Captions and basic QA here. Proposed filenames: redwood-vl-2026-06-26-<region>-vl0626-v1.mp4 and redwood-vl-2026-06-26-<region>-vl0626-v1.srt. We'll run model-driven auto-chaptering on the transcript to generate clip timestamps for highlights. TAT target: 36-48h for highlights, 72h for full edit.

Liam: Zoom checklist: Record to cloud (host-only), auto-transcription ON, disable participant local recording, spotlight presenter for first 90s. Player events: well use Streamline CDN heartbeats -> aggregator -> Amplitude + HubSpot. Ill post heartbeat schema in #eng-analytics.

Priya: Nurture plan: immediate TY + slide deck + 90s clip, 24h highlights email, 72h replay + one-page benchmark PDF for engineering buyers. A/B test subject lines on the 24h email. Drafts by EOD.

Jon: For watched_percent: aggregator dedupes heartbeats by session_id, computes percent, then POSTs to HubSpot. If disproportionate mismatch between HS contact and session_id, enrich via Clearbit email match. I'll create two end-to-end tests: (1) form submit -> HS contact -> tag; (2) playback -> watched_percent -> lifecycle update.

Sara: Asset flow post-event: 1) Zoom cloud record available, 2) download + transcript, 3) auto-chapter + human QA, 4) editorial trims: full replay, 4-6m highlights, 90s demo clip, 5) upload to GCS bucket gs://marketing-assets/virtual_lab_0626/ with metadata JSON alongside each object (event_code, region, redwood_id). If editorial backlog, escalate to Marketing Ops for vendor rush.

Maya: Retention: Zoom default 90d. We need 365d archival for research & enterprise customers; request infra to extend retention and sync final assets to GCS archival class. OpsBot: please remind infra.

OpsBot: Reminder: request Zoom retention extension at least 48 hours before event to avoid auto-deletion. Also list required scopes for HS API in the infra ticket.

Liam: Small privacy note: auto-chaptering uses summary model on transcripts; ensure transcripts are only processed within scoped account. I'll add privacy controls to the chapterer job.

Priya: Draft subject lines: Immediate: "Thanks  resources from the Virtual Lab"; 24h A1: "Top highlights from the Lab" A2: "Missed this? 4-minute highlight reel"; 72h: "Replay + benchmark brief for inference teams". Will include CTA to trial and to book a 20-min tech session.

Maya: Owners & due dates: Priya - reg page update (GDPR/UK consent + utm) and email drafts (EOD); Jon - HubSpot Zap + CS fallback + test matrix (48h); Liam - heartbeat schema + Zoom toggle screenshots in #eng-analytics (ASAP); Sara - caption QA checklist + chaptering sample + confirm TAT (tomorrow); Maya - infra ticket for 365d retention + GCS archival (now).

Maya: Tagging @here since this touches lead routing, privacy, and retention. Please reply here when your item is done. :thumbsup:
